expectedFunctionality: Convert a hexadecimal color to normalized hexadecimal, RGB and HSL values locally with explicit channel rounding.

rationale: No missing behavior required by the declared color-conversion job was found. Tickets 298-317 concern additional image editing/export workflows rather than this scalar color conversion contract and therefore remain additive, not blockers for this audit record.
